name: Taste LGD #5
description:
The taste of sea water,
The warmth of tea,
The sweet of maple syrup fresh dripped fresh from a tree,
The marmalade of summer,
The pumpkin pie of fall,
The cocoa of winter,
And the lemonade of spring
Just a few of life’s flavors,
That remind us,
That life is just beginning.
